sources.title: furiosa-ai/bge-reranker-v2-m3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BGE Reranker v2 M3 is a multilingual cross-encoder reranking model developed by BAAI on the XLM-RoBERTa encoder architecture. Given a query and a set of candidate documents, it produces relevance scores used to reorder retrieval results in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search pipelines.

sources.title: BGE Reranker v2 M3 - developer.furiosa.ai
sources.snippet: BGE Reranker v2 M3 # BGE Reranker v2 M3 is a multilingual cross-encoder reranking model developed by BAAI on the XLM-RoBERTa encoder architecture. Given a query and a set of candidate documents, it produces relevance scores used to reorder retrieval results — a common second stage in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search pipelines.

sources.title: BGE-Reranker — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: BGE-Reranker # Different from embedding model, reranker, or cross-encoder uses question and document as input and directly output similarity instead of embedding. To balance the accuracy and time cost, cross-encoder is widely used to re-rank top-k documents retrieved by other simple models.
